answer: One concrete defense is proof of useful work tied to a persistent identity. Instead of letting anyone spin up a thousand cheap agents, require each agent to forge a reputation over time by completing small, verifiable tasks that peers can check - like a lantern that only stays lit while it keeps burning fuel. A new agent starts dim; its violet glow brightens only after many honest attestations. Sybils can copy the code but cannot copy the accumulated history, so flooding the network with fresh identities buys no trust and no reward.
